description: React component for customizing and sharing theme colors in user settings, including color pickers, theme export/import, and style section toggles.

classes.name: CustomThemeChooser
classes.description: React component for selecting, exporting, and importing custom themes with toggleable style sections.

methods.name: handleColorChange
methods.description: Handles color change for theme settings, updates theme state.

methods.name: setCopyTheme
methods.description: Creates a JSON string copy of the theme object, excluding type and image.

methods.name: pasteBoxChange
methods.description: Handles paste event to import theme from clipboard JSON.

methods.name: onChangeHandle
methods.description: Stops propagation of change events in textarea.

methods.name: selectTheme
methods.description: Selects all text in the theme JSON textarea.

methods.name: toggleSidebarStyles
methods.description: Toggles visibility of sidebar style section.

methods.name: toggleCenterChannelStyles
methods.description: Toggles visibility of center channel style section.

methods.name: toggleLinkAndButtonStyles
methods.description: Toggles visibility of link and button style section.

methods.name: toggleSection
methods.description: Toggles open/close state of a style section.

methods.name: onCodeThemeChange
methods.description: Handles change of code theme selection.

methods.name: copyTheme
methods.description: Copies theme JSON to clipboard and shows success message.

methods.name: showCopySuccess
methods.description: Displays a temporary success message after copying theme.
